description: This file defines classes and methods related to executing vectorized Python UDFs using Arrow in Apache Spark. It includes the implementation of BatchIterator for batching, the ArrowEvalPythonExec class for executing Arrow-based Python UDFs, and the factory class ArrowEvalPythonEvaluatorFactory for evaluating these UDFs with support for different eval types.

classes.name: BatchIterator
classes.description: Iterator that batches elements into smaller iterators of a specified size.

classes.name: ArrowEvalPythonExec
classes.description: Physical plan node for evaluating vectorized Arrow Python UDFs in Spark.

classes.name: ArrowEvalPythonEvaluatorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating evaluators that run Arrow Python UDFs with batching support.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if the iterator has more elements.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the Arrow Python UDFs over an iterator of InternalRow, returning an iterator of InternalRow.

methods.name: withNewChildInternal
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ArrowEvalPythonExec with a different child plan.
